units.text: INT. TENT - CONTINUOUS
ROZ ABERNATHY, 38, in a bathrobe over scrubs, sits cross-legged on a sleeping bag.
Across from her, MILO ABERNATHY, 8, holds a flashlight under his chin.
A cell phone leans against a thermos between them, on speaker.
Are you sure he can hear us?
units.name: MILO

units.text: He can hear us.
units.name: ROZ

units.text: I can hear you, buddy. The connection's only a little bit bad.
units.name: CALVIN

units.text: Dad, it's cold in the tent.
units.name: MILO

units.text: Is it? Over here it's so hot I could fry an egg on my helmet.
units.name: CALVIN

units.text: Calvin.
units.name: ROZ

units.text: Sorry. Lieutenant's rules. No jokes about eggs.
units.name: CALVIN

units.text: Dad, when are you coming home?
units.name: MILO

units.text: Three more weeks, kiddo. Maybe less.
units.name: CALVIN

units.text: Mom said it was five.
units.name: MILO

units.text: I said around five.
units.name: ROZ

units.text: Your mom's a lawyer about it. She's always right.
units.name: CALVIN

units.text: I'm a nurse.
units.name: ROZ

units.text: That too.
units.name: CALVIN

units.text: Dad, do you see the same moon?
units.name: MILO

units.text: I think so. Is it the one with the face?
units.name: CALVIN

units.text: It's the one with the face.
units.name: MILO

units.text: Then I see it. I'm looking right at it.
units.name: CALVIN

units.text: Milo, tell Dad what you did at school.
units.name: ROZ

units.text: I got a sticker for reading out loud.
units.name: MILO

units.text: What book?
units.name: CALVIN

units.text: The one about the bear who can't sleep.
units.name: MILO

units.text: I love that one. Did you do the bear voice?
units.name: CALVIN

units.text: Grrr, I can't sleep.
units.name: MILO

units.text: That's perfect. That's the best bear I ever heard.
units.name: CALVIN

units.text: It's a quarter to ten, baby.
units.name: ROZ

units.text: Five more minutes.
units.name: MILO

units.text: Listen to your mom.
units.name: CALVIN

units.text: Okay. Goodnight, Dad.
units.name: MILO

units.text: Goodnight, Milo. Tell the moon I said hello.
units.name: CALVIN

units.text: I will.
units.name: MILO

units.text: Goodnight, Calvin.
units.name: ROZ

units.text: Love you both.
units.name: CALVIN

units.text: Love you.
units.name: ROZ

units.text: Love you.
units.name: MILO

units.text: The line clicks.
The flashlight flickers and goes out.
